about: 2.49: extra paper accounts next to your main one (Mandeep, 10 Nov 2026, points 14 and 15). Each has its own money and its own trades (saved as source '<feed>#<id>', never mixed with the main account, the scorecard or the test bench). Paper only: nothing here can place a real order. 'pick' = which alerts the account takes; 'paper' = its account rules (same names as the main account's); capital null = the same as your main capital. Change the numbers here; old trades keep the rules they were taken with. 2.56: 'exit_style' (a chart exit from lab/exits.py STYLES) gives an account its own exit for every trade; pick.same_as_main takes the main account's alert types and strength. 2.56.2: pick.mirror_main takes exactly the main account's trades (same alert, same lots); the main account's limits decide. 2.58: pick.multiverse takes test-bench signals that match the multiverse's live picks (data/multiverse.json), with the pick's strike and exit. 2.59: paper.index_slots keeps that many open-trade slots for the indices (0 = as before). 2.73: pick.situation takes Strategy Lab rule signals only when the market situation picker (lab/situation.py) says they fit today.

review.why: 3.05 (Mandeep, 24 Nov 2026: 'okay sab karo' on: after 20 market days every account against the main account on the same days; the losers switched off, their record kept). Retire = behind the main account over its days AND losing money. An account with review 'show' only gets the verdict (Pro: your call).

best.name: Best only
best.explain: Takes an alert only when everything agrees: it is a Focus alert, strength 3, the risk check says PASS, the signal score is 70 or more, and that alert type has a good live record (20+ graded, 55%+ worked, option up on average after an hour) or it comes from a Strategy Lab rule that passed the strict out-of-sample bar. Few trades by design.

target3.name: 3% a day
target3.short: Aims for +3% of the account a day, top alerts only
target3.explain: Starts from the capital you type, adds every day's result to the next day (compounding). Takes only top alerts (Focus, strength 3, risk PASS, score 75+), one trade at a time. When the day's profit (booked + open) reaches 3% of the morning's money, it closes everything and stops for the day; at -2% it does the same. Honest note: 3% every day compounds to about 1,600 times in a year; no strategy tested so far does that, so this account measures how often a day reaches +3%, not a promise.

trail.name: Trailing exit
trail.short: Same trades as the main account, trailing exit
trail.explain: Takes exactly the trades the main account takes (2.56.2: the same alert, the same number of lots, at the same moment) and differs only in how it exits: stop 1.5 x the 5-minute ATR of the index or stock, then a stop that trails 2.5 x ATR behind the best price, no fixed target, out by the day's exit time. Only in the first minutes after the scanner starts (no 5-minute bars yet) can it miss a trade. Why: on 15,370 graded alerts (2-9 Nov) this exit made +2.0% more on the option per trade than the +30% / -20% premium exit, better on 5 of 6 days. Your call (11 Nov): test it here first; if it keeps beating the main account, switching the main account is your decision.

halftrail.name: Half book · half trail
halftrail.short: Same trades as the main account: half the lots exit like the main account, the rest trail
halftrail.explain: 3.05 (Mandeep, 24 Nov 2026: 'okay sab karo'). Takes exactly the trades the main account takes (same alert, same moment, same number of lots) and splits each in two: half the lots (rounded down) exit exactly like the main account (its target, stop and time limit), the rest exit like the Trailing exit account (stop 1.5 x the 5-minute ATR, then a stop 2.5 x ATR behind the best price, no fixed target). One lot: trailed. Why: on the same 63 trades (12-23 Nov) the main account made +Rs13,410 and the Trailing exit account +Rs1,23,461, but the gain came from a few big runners (19 Nov Bank Nifty +Rs40.8K against +Rs6.9K) and the trailing exit gave back more on 18 and 23 Nov. This account books sure profit on half and lets the other half run. Paper only; switching the main account is your call.

mvpick.name: Multiverse pick
mvpick.short: Takes only the multiverse's proven picks
mvpick.explain: Every evening the multiverse replays every test-bench signal of the recorded days down millions of timelines (which signals, strike, entry time, exit) and keeps only the few whose lower confidence bound is above zero after charges, with days (not signals) as the units of proof. This account takes a live signal only when it matches one of those picks, with the pick's strike and exit, 1 lot, its own money and rules. When nothing is proven it takes nothing. Paper only, on trial: compare it with the main account on Accounts side by side.

idxslot.name: Index slot
idxslot.short: The main account's alerts, 1 of its slots kept for the indices
idxslot.explain: Takes the same alert types and strength as the main account (risk check PASS, lots from its own money), but never fills its last open-trade slot with a stock: one slot stays free for Nifty / Bank Nifty / Fin Nifty / Midcap Select. Why (11 Nov 2026): the main account's 3 slots were full of stock trades at 10:30, so it bought the Bank Nifty breakout only at 10:42, about 150 points later. If this account beats the main one over the coming weeks, keeping a slot for the indices in the main account is your call.

nolock.name: Main · no locks
nolock.short: The main account's alerts, no trades-a-day count, no day loss stop, no cool-off
nolock.explain: 3.04 (Mandeep, 24 Nov 2026: 'koi aisa lock nahi chahiye ki aache alert ya opportunity aaye market time me toh system trade hi na le; market situation dekhni hai but opportunity miss nahi karni'). Takes exactly the alerts the main account would (same alert types and strength, risk check PASS on everything except the day locks, lots from its own money), but has no trades-a-day count, no daily loss stop, no two-stop-losses cool-off, no good-day lock and no limit on open trades: the money is the only limit, one trade per symbol at a time. Why: 5-23 Nov the main account's day locks stopped 233 Focus alerts that passed every other check (206 by the trades-a-day count, 27 by the daily loss stop). Held 60 minutes they averaged -3.2% (85 of 233 up), but 28 went +30% or more at some point. This account shows with real paper trades what taking them earns. The main account changes only if this one beats it (your call).

ghanshyam.name: Ghanshyam
ghanshyam.short: Only Ghanshyam's strategies (course + 9:20), Nifty and Bank Nifty
ghanshyam.explain: Mandeep, 12 Nov 2026: a section of its own for Ghanshyam's strategies. This account takes only the signals of the Ghanshyam strategy files (rules/strategy_files/ghanshyam_course.json once uploaded) on Nifty and Bank Nifty: 1 lot each, once per strategy, symbol and day, the same paper rules (target, stop, time) as the main account. Own money and trades; never touches the main account. Every strategy here is still on trial.

autopick.name: Auto pick
autopick.short: Lab rules only when today's market situation suits them
autopick.explain: 2.73 (Mandeep, 13 Nov 2026: the system should understand the market and choose what is best for the situation). Takes a Strategy Lab rule's signal only when the situation picker expects it to make money in today's situation (day so far quiet / range / trend, with or against the day's move, VIX, expiry, gap, daily trend), learned from that rule's own Lab trades in each situation and checked on holdout days it never learned from. 1 lot, its own money and rules. Paper only, on trial: compare it with the main account on Accounts side by side.

strict.name: Strict
strict.short: Only alert types that passed the strict test
strict.explain: Takes an alert only when its alert type passed the strict test (System: Strict track): on the test bench, after the real spread and every charge, it made money on the learn days with a t-value above the multiple-testing bar, made money again on the holdout days it was never tuned on, and beat the coin-flip yardstick on both. The risk check must say PASS too. Until an alert type passes, this account stays in cash: that is the point of strict. Compare it with the main account (Explore) on the Strict track page.

rider.name: Trend Rider
rider.short: Only Trend Rider option buys, 1 lot, its own exit
rider.explain: 2.85 (Mandeep, 22 Nov 2026: option buying, every index and F&O stock, 1 lot, loss kam, premium time tak na ghise, trail profit bachaye par achha move na chhoote, strong initial stop). Takes only Trend Rider signals (on trial): buys the suggested option, 1 lot, with the money you set for the app. Exit: stop beyond the broken level on a 5-minute close (not a wick); at +1R the stop moves to entry (with 1 lot that is the booking); then a trail 2.5 ATR behind the best price that tightens to 1.5 ATR only when the candles show reversal signs; out if nothing moves in 3 bars; emergency stop -35% on the premium; out by 15:10. Own money and trades; never touches the main account. Paper only, on trial: compare it with the main account and the test bench.

pro_index.name: Pro · Index
pro_index.short: Stockway Pro v1: strong index signals only, 1 lot, no day locks, trail + profit lock
pro_index.explain: 3.01 Stockway Pro v1 (Mandeep, 24 Nov 2026: option buying only, every input voting together, strong checks). Buys only Trend Rider signals that Pro scores STRONG (85+ with 3+ different groups of checks agreeing; rules/pro.json), 1 lot, with the money you set for the app. 3.04 (Mandeep: no lock on good signals): no trades-a-day count, no day loss stop, no cool-off, no limit on open trades; the money you set for the app is the only limit, entries until 15:00. After 11:00 on a same-day expiry it still buys unless the move-vs-decay check votes against it. Exit: Trend Rider's (stop beyond the broken level on a 5-minute close, +1R stop to entry, ATR trail, no-move and 15:10 exits, -35% emergency) plus a profit lock: once the option is +50%, out if it falls back to +25%. Paper only, on trial: compare it with the main account day by day on the Day calendar. This account: indices (Nifty, Bank Nifty, Fin Nifty, Midcap Nifty...).

pro_stocks.name: Pro · Stocks
pro_stocks.short: Stockway Pro v1: strong F&O stock signals only, 1 lot, no day locks, trail + profit lock
pro_stocks.explain: 3.01 Stockway Pro v1 (Mandeep, 24 Nov 2026: option buying only, every input voting together, strong checks). Buys only Trend Rider signals that Pro scores STRONG (85+ with 3+ different groups of checks agreeing; rules/pro.json), 1 lot, with the money you set for the app. 3.04 (Mandeep: no lock on good signals): no trades-a-day count, no day loss stop, no cool-off, no limit on open trades; the money you set for the app is the only limit, entries until 15:00. After 11:00 on a same-day expiry it still buys unless the move-vs-decay check votes against it. Exit: Trend Rider's (stop beyond the broken level on a 5-minute close, +1R stop to entry, ATR trail, no-move and 15:10 exits, -35% emergency) plus a profit lock: once the option is +50%, out if it falls back to +25%. Paper only, on trial: compare it with the main account day by day on the Day calendar. This account: F&O stocks.

pro_stocks_strict.name: Pro · Stocks strict
pro_stocks_strict.short: Pro stock signals only with relative strength with us and order flow not already with us
pro_stocks_strict.explain: 3.07 challenger (Mandeep, 24 Nov 2026: 'okay' on the 6-day replay findings). The same strong Pro stock signals as Pro · Stocks, but only when the stock's relative strength votes with the trade AND the order flow is not already with it. 6 replayed days (6, 9, 13, 16, 18, 19 Nov, current code, 453 stock signals): these were +0.40R a signal, 60% won, 5 of 5 days up, about 36 a day; every strong stock signal: +0.18R, 54%, 3 of 5 days. With the flow already with the trade the move has mostly happened (late entry): -0.01R, 48%. Found on those 6 days only: this account tests it on new days next to Pro · Stocks. Same exit, 1 lot, no day locks, the money you set for the app.

pro2_index.name: Pro v2 · Index
pro2_index.short: Stockway Pro v2: strong index signals, 1 lot, chart-level exit (10 EMA runner, profit lock)
pro2_index.explain: 3.08 Stockway Pro v2 (Mandeep, 25 Nov 2026: 'entry exit koi percentage se nahi chart ... price levels, indicators, resistance support se'). The same strong Pro index signals as Pro · Index (v1 stays as the control), 1 lot, exit from the chart: the setup's stop on a 5-minute close; T1 / T2 = the next support / resistance zones (yesterday's high / low / close, pivots, last week, 20-day, today's range, round numbers); before T1 out on a failed breakout or no move in 30 minutes; at T1 the stop goes to the entry level and then follows the 10 EMA of the 5-minute closes; profit lock +20% -> keep +5%; emergency -35%; out by 15:10 (rules/pro_v2.json). 7-day replay with the real engine: every index version was about flat or lost (14 signals, 29% won): this one +Rs842, v1 -Rs250, 2 lots -Rs9,126 to -Rs15,178. Index entries are the weak part of Pro: judged on new days. No day locks. Paper only, on trial.

pro2_stocks.name: Pro v2 · Stocks
pro2_stocks.short: Stockway Pro v2: confirmed strong stock signals, not chasing, 2 lots when the money covers them, chart-level exit
pro2_stocks.explain: 3.08 Stockway Pro v2. Strong Pro stock signals only when (1) relative strength is with the trade and order flow not already with it (the strict checks), (2) the main account's risk check passed an alert on the same stock and side in the last 15 minutes (confirmed), (3) the price is not already beyond VWAP +/- 2 sigma the trade's way (Aseem's band as a no-chase check, from the Vote Lab). Signals of one bar: the best score first (a pause at the level before the break, Ghanshyam's point, adds a bonus). 2 lots when the free money covers both, else 1; exit from the chart: the setup's stop on a 5-minute close; T1 / T2 from support / resistance; before T1 out on a failed breakout or no move in 30 minutes; after T1 the stop goes to the entry level and follows the 10 EMA of the 5-minute closes; emergency -35%; out by 15:10. 7-day replay with the real engine: 25 entries, +Rs41,410 a lot (Rs1,656 a lot a trade, PF 3.49, green 2 of 4 traded days, worst day -Rs6,544 a lot) against Pro · Stocks strict's 188 trades +Rs69,128 (Rs368 a trade) and the trailing account's Rs1,338 a lot a trade. A stock bought in the 09:20-09:30 window is not bought again that day. No day locks. Paper only, on trial.

pro2_stocks_rider.name: Pro v2 · Stocks rider exit
pro2_stocks_rider.short: Challenger: Pro v2's confirmed stock entries with Trend Rider's exit, 2 lots
pro2_stocks_rider.explain: 3.08 challenger to Pro v2 · Stocks: the same confirmed, not-chasing stock entries, but Trend Rider's own exit (stop beyond the broken level on a 5-minute close, +1R stop to entry, ATR trail, no-move, 15:10), no profit lock, 2 lots on one trade when the money covers them. 7-day replay: +Rs71,113 at 2 lots (Rs1,422 a lot a trade, PF 3.18), second to the chart exit with the 10 EMA runner per lot. The new market days decide between them. Paper only, on trial.

pro2_early.name: Pro v2 · Early
pro2_early.short: Pro v2: strong breakouts of the first 5-minute candle between 09:20 and 09:30, 1 lot, chart-level exit
pro2_early.explain: 3.08 (Mandeep, 25 Nov 2026: 'kyi baar strong move 9:20 se 9:30 mein hi mil jaate hai 5 min ke candle ke baad'). Trend Rider's first signal is at 09:30; this account looks at 09:20-09:30 only: a 1-minute close beyond the first 5-minute candle's high (calls) / low (puts) that also went through a key level (yesterday's high / low / close, pivot, R1 / S1, CPR, last week, a round number), with a strong score (the first candle strong, gap and candle the same way, the right side of VWAP, the index with it or the stock far stronger, order flow with it, a tradable option, no chase; 85+). 1 lot; stop at the middle of the first candle on 1-minute closes; then the chart-level exit (T1 / T2 from the levels). Index and stocks. The main account's 09:20-09:30 trades: replay +Rs44,767, live -Rs20,474: a risky window, so 1 lot and its own account (switch it off alone if it fails). Paper only, on trial. 7-day replay with the real engine: +Rs21,988 on 105 trades (PF 1.35, worst day -Rs3,330) but green on only 2 of 6 days: the 20 live days decide.
